result:
Round 154 (V-2b-2) is implemented and ready for C. I have not checked it in a browser: the computed weights, Plex Mono rendering, layout movement and clipping are all still unverified.

**What changed (only the 13 granted files plus the new doc 125)**
- **Weights:** nothing under `app/components/arrangement` uses `font-semibold` or `font-bold` any more. The workspace `h1`, the Library `h2`, the group-name and group mix buttons, Master Mute and the lane M/S buttons are now `font-medium` (W1–W5). The Master peak's over state lost its `font-medium`, so it stays at 400 (W6).
- **Mono numerals (N1–N6):** library row durations, the library playhead, ruler labels, tempo-row bar labels, the clip-gain "0 dB" reset and the lane-move ghost's start time.
  - For N1, Biome made me reformat the whole ternary. The loading and error text is identical; only the line layout changed.
  - The zoom readout, pan readout, `4/4`, library counts, the two selects and the preview duration stay sans, as B ruled.
- **Tests:** new test TH10, the one-line T2 fix in `render-budget`, and the T3 assertions in the library-row test.
  - A probe of the server-rendered page decided how TH10 checks each item. Ones that render on first load (h1, h2, Mute/Solo, playhead, ruler labels, gain reset) are checked in that output.
  - The ones that don't (tempo labels, ghost, group header, the peak's over state) are checked by their exact class strings in the source files.
- **Docs:** doc 124's status line is updated (D1). The new doc 125 is in Georgian with the template sections and status `In Progress (awaiting C round 154)`.

**Checks I ran**
- **Tests:** 21 files (the 8 listed, the group-header and clip-gain tests, and `grid-musical-ui`) went from 292/292 before to 293/293 after; the new one is TH10.
- **Typecheck and lint:** both exit 0. Lint's 218 warnings are elsewhere in the repo, none in the changed files.
- **Biome on the 12 changed code and test files:** clean.
- **Mutations:** m137, m138 and m140 each turn only TH10 red; m139 turns only the library-row test red. I added m139b (the inner span loses `font-mono`), which also turns only the library-row test red.
  - Every mutation was restored and checked against the saved hashes. I ran them twice: before and after the review fix.
  - In the second pass I briefly had two mutations applied at once. I restored one before running anything, so each recorded run tests a single mutation.
- **End state:** the 959 frozen files match. The protected files have no diff, and `app.css`, `studio-lab.tsx` and `package.json` are unchanged. `git status` shows the 13 granted modified files plus doc 125.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent scored it 9/10 with only Low findings. I fixed two in TH10:
- it now scans `.ts` as well as `.tsx` and needs at least 20 files;
- it also catches `font-extrabold`, `font-black` and arbitrary values like `font-[600]`.

Three I left and recorded:
- The over-state check would miss `font-medium` added as a separate class argument. C's computed-weight check covers that.
- Nothing checks that the loading and error durations stay sans. That test is outside my grant, so it is a proposal for B.
- In mono, ruler labels of 10:00 or more fill the whole 40 px spacing and may touch. C's no-clip/overlap row should include such a zoom if one is reachable.

Its Architecture note, verbatim: "none".

**Not run by me:** the full suite, `npm run verify`, the build, e2e and every browser row. Nothing was committed or pushed, and the backlog is not marked complete. My reports are `a-round-154.md` and the `a-round-154/` folder; `a-round-154-result.json` is written by the loop itself, not by me.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- a-round-154.md
- a-round-154/
